# Client SDK group: what each client implements on its side of SDK v1

Generated by `scripts/conformance/build.ts` from the widget headers. Contract: `docs/sdk-v1.md`. Each widget is a v1 mini-widget (at most 4 KB gzipped, 32 KB of HTML); post it as a widget message with its picture as a separate image next to it (two pictures: light and dark). A tester does what the instruction says and checks the client against the expected behaviour. Rows marked *waits* need server support first; they are here so the client side can be built against them.

| # | Widget | Picture | The tester | The client must | Contract | gzip |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 01 | [openLink: the confirmation shows the full URL](01-link-external.html) | [light](../../refs/visual/sdk/01-link-external.png) | Tap each button. Each time the client asks first and shows the whole URL (path, query; the IDN host in its xn-- form), then opens the browser. | A native confirmation with the full URL and Open / Cancel; Open goes to the browser (or the in-app browser, as the client usually does). | docs/sdk-v1.md §2.5, §5.2 | 1.7 KB |

The cached height is used next time the auto bubbles scroll in. | Width 0 = the bubble's width, W = a fixed width clamped to [200, max]; height 0 = auto (placeholder, then the reported 240 clamped to [50, 600], cached per message), H = a fixed clamp(H, 50, 600) that the content does not change. | docs/sdk-v1.md §5.6 | 1.5 KB |
